image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a small mustelid (weasel/stoat) standing in tall green grass. The animal has reddish-brown fur on its head and back, with white/cream fur on its chest and underbelly. It features a pointed snout, dark glossy eyes, and small rounded ears. The body is partially obscured by the foreground vegetation.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is clearly visible, exhibiting the characteristic triangular profile and pointed muzzle of a weasel.
Eyes are visible, dark, and proportionate to the head size.
Ears are visible on the top of the head, appearing short and rounded as expected.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The majority of the body is occluded by tall grass and the framing cuts off the rear; only the head and upper chest are clearly visible, making full body proportion assessment impossible.

The boundary between the lower jaw and the white chest fur is slightly indistinct and soft, lacking the crisp anatomical definition expected in a high-resolution macro shot.

alignment_reasoning: The image strongly aligns with the 'weasel' class. All testable facial and fur checkpoints passed perfectly. The failure to verify body/limb checkpoints is due to occlusion/framing rather than generation error. The visible anatomy is consistent with the taxonomy.
artifact_reasoning: The image is largely coherent but suffers from subtle AI artifacts. The primary issues are the unnatural, plastic sheen of the eye and inconsistent depth-of-field rendering in the grass, which creates a slight 'composite' look. These are minor but prevent a perfect quality score.
